independence: Inspected own raw original snapshot, frozen target, GLOBAL warm-soft reference, own original source collection/actions and required native replay before editor proposals or other-object aesthetic conclusions. No editor proposals or other-object aesthetic verdicts were read.
sourceObservations: The original front/back view is an upright cyan open ring in oblique projection, with blue small orbiting runes and two dark blue faceted rock feet. The lower arc is partly hidden by the feet; the central opening remains empty.
Broad cyan facets read clearly, but the ring has abrupt light/value bands, small blue details have little crafted definition, and the foot facets can collapse to near-black navy areas.

The side views are physically edge-on, with a narrow cyan spine above two support rocks. They must retain believable thickness and distinguishable end/side construction; forcing identical front-facing silhouettes would violate actual source orientation.

Native replay shows one pulse and a short orbit of the rune pieces; fixed support rocks retain their ground relationship. This is separate geometry and object transform animation, not a screen-space fill or opaque portal disk.
targetObservations: The frozen target keeps the cyan/blue open-ring identity and dark blue paired supports, while introducing fuller rounded transitions, clearer layered rim construction, jewel-like blue panels, restrained gold collars and foot accents, and broad soft light gradients with bright edge highlights.

Its improved support/rim interfaces and deliberate accent hierarchy are useful native design opportunities. Exact old torus/part counts, blank feet, facet topology and rune count are not quality requirements.

Its ragged luminous edge noise, unusually sharp glints and image-space ring proportions are not technical evidence and should not be copied as artifacts, baked glow outlines, camera-facing artwork, or registration changes.
styleReferenceObservations: The plant reference uses clearly grouped volumes, broad readable facets, softened edge transitions, strong but organized color separation, and warm highlights. Transfer that friendly sculpted material/light language while retaining the portal's cool cyan and navy palette family.

Gold accents suggested by this target can be subordinate purposeful details; cyan ring and blue support identity must remain dominant. Root should reconcile the allowed accent palette, rather than treating the reference's pot color as a required wholesale portal recolor.
rankedVisibleGoals: A sculpted, substantial open ring with softly readable thickness and coherent structure in every facing, including edge-on E/W.
Readable navy supports and purposeful rim/panel accents, with soft volume rather than flat cyan bands or black facet voids.
A clean one-shot pulse with stable support contact, clear opening, readable small-size details and no clipping, halos, shimmer, or directional ground shadows.
nativeEvidence: preparation-v1/source-inspection.json and preparation-v1/native-measurements.json; measurements are enabled authored RAW and evaluated geometry separately, not hidden saved bounds.
approval: No candidate, family, production, Godot or publishing approval. Criteria and design budget remain proposals until ROOT reconciliation.
